# Colossen (Vedant Deshmukh)

Personal site of Vedant Deshmukh, who publishes as Colossen. Computer
engineering student in India. He builds systems from scratch, mostly in Rust,
C++, and Python.

## Profile

- Role: Computer engineering student
- Location: India (IST)
- GitHub: https://github.com/Vedant9500
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vedant-deshmukh-82441928b/
- Telegram: https://t.me/Vedant_s_d
- Website: https://colossen.com/

## Pages

- [Home](https://colossen.com/): introduction, quick facts, personal links,
  and selected work.
- [Work](https://colossen.com/work/): every public project, plus a selection
  of private ones.
- [About](https://colossen.com/about/): background, projects, off-screen.
- [Glassbox](https://colossen.com/work/glassbox/): symbolic regression.
- [FMMS](https://colossen.com/work/fmms/): fast-multipole N-body in Rust,
  with a live 160-body browser demo.
- [freeze-bench](https://colossen.com/work/freeze-bench/): execution-graded
  coding eval.
- [Hark](https://colossen.com/work/hark/): Linux command palette.
- [OpenLMlib](https://colossen.com/work/openlmlib/): local knowledge library
  for coding agents, with 76 MCP tools.

## Public projects

### Glassbox
Symbolic regression engine that recovers readable equations from data.
598/615 on its local benchmark, September 2026.
Stack: Python, C++.
https://github.com/Vedant9500/Glassbox

### Hark
Native Linux command palette. A resident Rust daemon with a GTK4 overlay.
About 8 microseconds median app search across roughly 9,100 indexed items.
Stack: Rust, GTK4.
https://github.com/Vedant9500/Hark

### freeze-bench
Execution-graded benchmark for coding models. 32 active tasks. The model
never sees git history, the fix commit, the rubric, or the network.
Stack: Shell.
https://github.com/Vedant9500/freeze-bench

### FMMS
Fast-multipole N-body solver in Rust. Verified O(N) scaling, and 48x faster
than direct summation at one million bodies. The project page runs a live
160-body direct-summation demo in the browser.
Stack: Rust.
https://github.com/Vedant9500/FMMS

### OpenLMlib
Local knowledge library for coding agents, with persistent, searchable memory
over SQLite, JSON findings, and semantic search. 76 MCP tools.
Stack: Python, SQLite.
https://colossen.com/work/openlmlib/
https://github.com/Vedant9500/OpenLMlib

### WTF
Natural-language search for shell commands, about 6,600 entries.
Stack: Go.
https://github.com/Vedant9500/WTF

### CelestialSim
RK4 N-body simulation in the browser.
Stack: JavaScript.
https://github.com/Vedant9500/CelestialSim

### Jikan Fetcher
Anime filler-episode list fetcher.
Stack: Go.
https://github.com/Vedant9500/Jikan_Filler_Fetcher

## Private work

Other repositories are private until they are ready to be read. A selection is
named with one-line descriptions on the Work page: assay, rt-approx,
rusty-ocean, grist, LiNN, CLOE, VEA, AD-DSP, Blastd.
